NIST2024.role: Independent NIST confirmation of 2024 Playground's TEDS, network and transducer service education/validation scope

IMLPlayground.role: 2024 technical worked forms for TEDS and service-message fields; not IEEE publisher-owned normative text

NISTHistorical.role: Earlier historical educational TEDS example; not a 2024 clause verification

reviewedRows.publisherOrTechnicalLocator: IEEE SA 1451.0-2024 published scope (NCAP/1451 server); IML Playground Network Services §10, Table 54 APP↔NCAP
reviewedRows.nativeMeaning: NCAP is the network-facing IEEE 1451 processor/server that exposes network services to applications and communicates with TIMs.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Network-facing service function is not every network-visible physical device, a sensor probe, a gateway by label alone, or a guaranteed CSAPI System resource.

reviewedRows.publisherOrTechnicalLocator: IEEE SA 1451.0-2024 published scope (TIM); IML Playground Transducer Services §11, Tables 64–70
reviewedRows.nativeMeaning: TIM supplies the transducer interface-side functions, addressed channels and services; may be implemented in multiple physical/electronic arrangements.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: An architectural TIM role does not prove separately identifiable physical part, enclosure, installed component identity or containment relation.

reviewedRows.publisherOrTechnicalLocator: IML Playground transducer-channel TEDS §6.5 / Table 19; Transducer Services §11.1.3 (TIM and channel identifiers)
reviewedRows.nativeMeaning: An individually addressed IEEE 1451 transducer-interface channel with associated data/service behavior and channel-specific TEDS information.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Not necessarily one physical sensor or probe, LoRaWAN FPort, SDI-12 address, reported output field, SWE DataRecord item or CSAPI DataStream.

reviewedRows.publisherOrTechnicalLocator: IML Playground 1451.0-2024 TransducerChannel TEDS §6.5 / Table 19, Sampling.SampMode
reviewedRows.nativeMeaning: TransducerChannel TEDS Sampling.SampMode identifies available sampling-mode capability.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Capabilities are not evidence of the mode actually selected or executed, and are not universal operating-mode descriptions for the whole sensing System.

reviewedRows.publisherOrTechnicalLocator: IML Playground 1451.0-2024 TransducerChannel TEDS §6.5 / Table 19, Sampling.SDefault
reviewedRows.nativeMeaning: TransducerChannel TEDS Sampling.SDefault represents the declared default sampling mode.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: A manufacturer/default TEDS value does not prove a fielded unit's actual current or historical mode, or a whole-System default.

reviewedRows.publisherOrTechnicalLocator: IML Playground 1451.0-2024 Meta TEDS §6.4 / Table 13 (UUID); Network Services §10 (timId)
reviewedRows.nativeMeaning: Public 1451 Playground Meta TEDS identifies a 128-bit UUID used to identify a TIM; network-service messages also distinguish timId and ncapId.
reviewedRows.nonEquivalenceBoundary: TIM UUID is not automatically a CSAPI System URI, persistent station ID, manufacturer serial number, or authenticated identity of a deployed individual; fielded existence and issuer authority unproven.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: Meta TEDS: MaxChan, CGroup, VGroup, Proxies
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Channel counts, control/vector groupings and proxy channels are declarations, not individual physical probes, physical wiring or installed count verification.
Units and channel data model metadata do not alone identify the observed feature, original measurement result, CSAPI schema or object identity.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: TransducerChannel TEDS: CalKey; optional Calibration TEDS
nativeLeads.sourceLocator: IEEE Playground §6.5/Table 19 and Optional TEDS calibration section
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Calibration method/coefficients or schedule are not automatically actual calibration event, certification, observed quality or field-history evidence.
Design limits, worst-case uncertainty and self-test capability differ from current diagnostics, measured uncertainty and performed self-test result.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: SPeriod, UpdateT, WarmUpT, RSetupT, TimeSrc, TSError
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Declared sampling/timing parameters and timing-source metadata are not original phenomenonTime or resultTime of NOAA means or fielded applied settings.

nativeLeads.sourceLocator: IEEE Playground §6.11 / User’s Transducer Name TEDS
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Readable/user-defined names do not equal individual factory serial numbers, uniquely verified equipment identity or deployed station identifiers.
Transducer channel type or data-model descriptors are not a guarantee of one physical sensor, one output field, or one actual sampled event.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: Network Services: discovery, transducer access, TEDS access, event notification
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: IEEE APP↔NCAP service message types are distinct from native CSAPI REST resources, interfaces or proof of a real registered network participant.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: TIM/Transducer Service Commands: Query/Read/Write/Update TEDS, Run self-test
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Documented command/service types are affordances; they do not prove an issued request, authenticated permission or actual hardware action.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: Transducer service reply: Success/Fail, ErrorCode and status condition
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Protocol reply or self-test status is not independent evidence that the requested physical effect occurred or was observed.

nativeLeads.sourceLocator: IEEE Playground Optional TEDS, geographic location section
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Optional or manually entered installation location cannot establish surveyed per-probe coordinates, original location precision or time-dated deployment without source evidence.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: Optional Security TEDS / Time Synchronization TEDS
nativeLeads.sourceLocator: IEEE Playground Optional TEDS, security/time sections
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Declaration of a supported security or time synchronization protocol does not establish the current authorization configuration, signed original issuer claims or absolute resultTime.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: PHY TEDS: Radio / Battery / Encrypt / Authent
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: THIS IS A DIFFERENT IEEE FAMILY STANDARD AND 2007 EDITION, NOT PROOF IEEE 1451.0-2024 REQUIRES THESE FIELDS; Battery indicates design/power type, not present charge level.

nativeLeads.nativeTerm: Historical NIST TEDS overview: manufacturer, serial, calibration descriptions
nativeLeads.sourceLocator: NIST historical TEDS educational overview (original 2009 STIM-era context)
nativeLeads.nonEquivalenceBoundary: NIST historical description cannot verify a particular 1451.0-2024 normative field path, a modern TIM self-ID value, or a serial-numbered installed transducer.

prohibitedOverclaims: No independent access to full licensed IEEE 1451.0-2024 normative requirements, clause SHALLs or test conditions.
IML Playground's §5.3 PHY TEDS cites IEEE 1451.5-2007, not IEEE 1451.0-2024.
Older NIST STIM-era TEDS overview cannot prove 2024 field requirements.
No installed NCAP, TIM, TransducerChannel, actual channel mode, real calibration, physical Command outcome, or real original IEEE observation verified.
